connector.name: seekrit (local crypto plane)
connector.registryDescription: Zero-knowledge secrets manager - local crypto-plane MCP server: decrypts and injects secrets.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.seekrit. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SEEKRIT_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Machine (M2M) client id from POST https://mcp.seekrit.dev/signup — mints an admin token automatically, no separate token to copy.

env.name: SEEKRIT_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Machine (M2M) client secret paired with SEEKRIT_CLIENT_ID.

env.name: SEEKRIT_TOKEN
env.description: An existing skt_… service or admin token, if you already have one instead of machine credentials.

env.name: SEEKRIT_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Passphrase for the token's private key. Required for tools that decrypt (get_secret, run_command) when authenticating with SEEKRIT_TOKEN.

env.name: SEEKRIT_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the hosted seekrit API.
